fixture_needs: Replace createHarness throwing ATDD_UNBOUND with the actual scheduling reader. These typed interfaces are test-owned normalization, not new production APIs; preserve the raw descriptor unchanged. Do not return seed-derived expected rows.

Use existing local role-aware tenant/auth and booking factories: two isolated tenants, manager and own current membership/profile mapping, peer profile, own/shared/peer/foreign bookings, safe job/customer/work-role labels and real sensitive columns. Bind scenario.actorId as manager user; own user and person-profile identity must differ.

Fixture-adapter managerRoles/ownRoles/deniedRoles must set both scalar memberships and membership_roles so secondary union grants are exercised with valid authentication; stale tests reuse the issued session after DB updates.

Capture actual reader source page offsets, stable order, tenant predicate, row IDs and failures, plus identity picker/profile/hours/calendar access. Exclude authorization membership checks from scheduling fact-read trace. Never use service-role application reads.
Map actual ready/denied/retryable error state without treating failed raw zero-count defaults as known zero. Verify retryable state separately from denied.

Seed 501/1001 valid planned in-period booking rows with independent seed IDs and page-edge sentinels. Ancillary 501/1001 fixtures need valid conflict logical identities, roster/membership lifecycle rows, shift/break/exception rows and calendar dates; source facts must be relevant to the real query.

If bounded calendar predicates cannot produce 500+ valid dates, test the actual paging helper with instrumented transport rows and label those cases mocked transport; do not invent a broad public date API or fabricate production schema.
Inject failure at source offset 1000 through the actual reader transport, capture private underlying error, preserve read input and restore transport for retry.

Snapshot bookings, assignees, conflicts, booking command outcomes and audit rows in both tenants before read/unreviewed checked saves. Wire tryUnreviewedSave to existing real checked booking action/RPC without generating receipt/review authority; real overlapping shared booking supplies conflict facts.

Ensure cleanup through dispose in finally using existing tenant/booking fixture cleanup; fail required integration when local stack unavailable (SUPABASE_TEST_REQUIRED=1), never target demo. Remove skip only for the current implementation task and observe RED before GREEN.

Seed distinct open own-visible, peer-only and foreign logical conflicts. expectedOwnOpenConflictCount must be an independent fixture expectation; do not compute it by reading the scheduling response or count peer-only associations.
